annotations.text:
What reads as off:

1. "Mark it done" sits 35px from the card edge (19px card + 16px button padding) while everything above starts at 19px.
2. Bottom air is 28px vs 17px at the top - the card looks like it is sliding down.
3. Title is Caprasimo faked to 600 at 15px, so it smudges; time and note are both 12.5px, so the hierarchy flattens.
4. Gaps go 10 / 2 / 8 / 12 / 12 with no rhythm.

Option A keeps the anatomy, fixes the geometry:

- quiet action loses its horizontal padding, so its text lands on the 19px content edge
- padding 18 / 19 / 10, so top and bottom air match once the button's own 10px is counted
- title at Caprasimo's real 400 weight, 17px
- rhythm 12 / 4 / 10 / 14 / 4
- Tabler X instead of the heavier x glyph

Tradeoff: the quiet action's hit area no longer reaches the card edge on the left.

Option B adds structure: a hairline splits content from an action lane, so "Mark it done" reads as a deliberate escape route rather than a label floating under a button.

Tradeoff: one more rule on a 250px card, and the lane costs ~8px of height. Worth it only if other rail cards adopt the same lane.
